\Sigma=(\mathcal F,\mathcal R,\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal F},\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal R}),
\qquad
\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathbb N,
\qquad
\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal R}:\mathcal R\to\mathbb N

\mathsf{HenkinStruct}_{\Sigma}
=
\{(D,I_{\mathcal F},I_{\mathcal R},\{H_n\}_{n\in\mathbb N}):
D\ne\varnothing
\land
\forall f\in\mathcal F\ I_{\mathcal F}(f):D^{\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal F}(f)}\to D
\land
\forall R\in\mathcal R\ I_{\mathcal R}(R)\subseteq D^{\operatorname{ar}_{\mathcal R}(R)}
\land
\forall n\in\mathbb N\ \varnothing\ne H_n\subseteq\mathcal P(D^n)\}.

\Delta_{\mathsf{Henkin}}(H)
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists D\,\exists I_{\mathcal F}\,\exists I_{\mathcal R}\,
\exists \{H_n\}_{n\in\mathbb N}\,
\Bigl(
H=(D,I_{\mathcal F},I_{\mathcal R},\{H_n\}_{n\in\mathbb N})
\in\mathsf{HenkinStruct}_{\Sigma}
\land
\forall n\in\mathbb N\,
\varnothing\ne H_n\subseteq\mathcal P(D^n)
\Bigr).
